reviewer: an independent reviewer agent that saw only the screenshots (no code), six fresh reviewers in all, one per round
screens: phone 393 px light, phone dark, wide 1360 px light; first screen of each page; a terminale profile and a list of 3 vœux

visual_hierarchy.why: Home, Observatoire and Mes vœux each open on one strong block, and L'essentiel leads the formation page with the peach access cell; on wide screens the profile strip, the line « Les résultats sont lus pour… » and the step tracker compete under the hero, and the zone tile is mostly empty.

consistency.why: Cards, edges, hard shadows, pills, the bottom bar and the selected states repeat across pages and themes; Mes vœux stacked three notice styles, one Mon profil situation card has no radio, the profile strip is full width on search only.

style_fidelity.why: Clearly balanced Neo Brutalism: cream ground, thick ink edges, unblurred offset shadows, flat peach, pale yellow and violet tiles with ink text, one yellow call to action, tilted capital badges limited to the search cards and the home; data tiles straight; the dark theme keeps cream edges.

readability.why: Phone body text is comfortable with good contrast; density is high in places: the peach cell's source line, an eight-line bold alert, Observatoire axis labels oversized next to a tiny legend.

primary_action_clarity.why: Home and search each have exactly one yellow action, secondary actions are outlined; on the formation page « Retirer de mes vœux » and « Comparer » have the same weight.

navigation_and_orientation.why: The selected tab is unmistakable in the bottom bar and the top menu, Comprendre and Plus light up on the Observatoire; the home step tracker used the selected violet for a step to do.

dark_theme_quality.why: Designed, not inverted: near-black ground, cream edges and shadows, the yellow action kept, zone pills legible, a readable dark alert; the dimmed pale-yellow tiles turn slightly olive.

responsive_layout.why: No overflow or cut; the phone stacks the peach cell's halves cleanly and the wide search page uses the full width; the phone chrome (three-line tagline, profile bar, bottom bar) is heavy and 1360 px pages sit in a narrow column.

trust_and_tone.why: Credible and sober: sources and years written out, officiel and estimation separated, « ce ne sont pas vos chances » on every relevant page; the large Robustesse score could read as a grade.

accessibility_signals.why: Zones combine colour, shape and name, selected states use fill plus edge, the alert pairs a « ! » with text, controls look at least 44 px; the lightest Observatoire series and some small grey text are weak points.

suggestions: Reduce the phone chrome: the header tagline on fewer lines or under the logo.
One notice family in Mes vœux: keep the strong alert, one shared style for the others; the alert's text in regular weight.
Step tracker: a mark per status and no selected violet for a step to do.
Observatoire: axis labels at body size, a bigger legend, the lightest series darker.
L'essentiel on wide screens: fill the zone tile; a less dominant Robustesse numeral.
Polish: radio on the third situation card, one profile strip width, skeleton lines instead of « chargement… ».
